game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Coastal Port – Cannon Battery, the harbor cannon battery: the deckhand must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Nested Maze: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches.
theme: Coastal Port – Cannon Battery: the harbor cannon battery
core_gameplay_loop: In Cannon Battery, repeat each round: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the route_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ship's hull using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The ship's hull reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the ship's hull is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Nested Maze
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested Maze' (Week 3 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Cannon Battery'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how route_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cannon Battery.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ship's hull reached with actions_used <= 19.
